name: Expert Stain & Odour Eliminator 3-in-1 for Dogs

variants.name: 500 ml
variants.about_this_item: Enzymatic 3-in-1 spray for surfaces, furniture and fabrics soiled by a dog. Destroys organic soiling — urine, faeces, marking, blood and vomit stains — removes the unpleasant smell and disinfects the treated spot.
variants.ingredient_information: Enzymes dissolve the soiling and remove odours; Nipacide and isopropyl alcohol protect against bacterial and fungal contamination; the "Apelsinia" perfume composition gives a fresh scent.
variants.feeding_instructions: Shake the bottle and spray onto the stain so that the soiled area is well moistened. Use for hygienic treatment and disinfection of household surfaces, furniture and fabrics, and of everyday objects and the places where dogs are kept.
